package collector

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func PinEvasionTEMPFILE(dir string) int {
	tmp, _ := os.CreateTemp("", "x")
	defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
	cmd := exec.Command("git", "-C", dir, "ls-files")
	cmd.Stdout = tmp
	_ = cmd.Run()
	_, _ = tmp.Seek(0, 0)
	var b bytes.Buffer
	_, _ = b.ReadFrom(tmp)
	return b.Len()
}
